test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Four sentences are given, out of which three have spelling errors. Choose the sentence with all correctly spelt words.

options.text: They superseded the old statute with a new one.
They will be celebrating their twelth anniversary this April.
He had no sense of rhythme whatsoever.
I wrote her a reciept for the money.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The sentence with **all correctly spelled **words is: *"They superseded the old statute with a new one." *

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** The correct spelling is "twelfth," not "twelth."
 
• **Option 3:** The correct spelling is "rhythm," not "rhythme."
 
• **Option 4: **The correct spelling is "receipt," not "reciept."
